entries.0d49d88b5deb4433: This business manufactures and sells paper and its raw materials, including printing and writing paper, paperboard, specialty paper and pulp. The company manufactures and sells printing and writing paper, and the company together with Nihon Kami Tsusho Co., Ltd. and others also handles purchase and sale. Jujo Thermal manufactures and sells thermal paper and other products, mainly for the European market. The company and others manufacture and sell paperboard, and Nihon Tokai Industrial Paper Supply Co., Ltd. and others are in charge of sales. Nippon Papylia Co., Ltd. and others manufacture and sell specialty paper, and the company and others carry out manufacturing, purchasing and sales of pulp. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥557,863 million (¥565,911 million in the prior year; down 1.4% year on year), the largest among reportable segments. Domestic sales volume of printing and writing paper rose above the prior year, despite continued declines in demand, partly due to business withdrawals by other companies. Meanwhile, export sales volume of printing and writing paper fell below the prior year, owing to deteriorating market conditions and other factors.

Nihon Seishi Mokuzai Co., Ltd. and others handle purchase and sale of wood, Nihon Seishi Mokuzai Co., Ltd. handles purchase and sale of building materials, N&E Co., Ltd. and others manufacture and sell building materials, and Nihon Seishi Unitech Co., Ltd. and others carry out civil engineering and construction. entries.b58153e1d2c4e989: This business manufactures and sells products used in daily life and packaging, including household paper, miscellaneous paper, processed paper products, corrugated cardboard and chemical products. Household paper is manufactured and sold by Nippon Paper Crecia Co., Ltd. and others. For processed paper products, the company and others manufacture and sell paper containers and other items; Ｏｐａｌ manufactures and sells paper boxes mainly for the Australian market; Nippon Dynawave Packaging manufactures and sells base paper for liquid paper containers mainly for North America; and Lintec Corporation manufactures and sells adhesive-related products. Corrugated cardboard is manufactured by Ｏｐａｌ and Nippon Tokan Package Co., Ltd., and chemical products are manufactured by the company and sold by Furorikku Co., Ltd., Nihon Kami Tsusho Co., Ltd. and others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥482,017 million (¥457,880 million in the prior year; up 5.3%), the second largest category among reportable segments. For household paper, revenue from the Crecia Miyagi Plant, which began operating in fiscal 2024, contributed throughout the year, and revenue rose above the prior year. For liquid paper containers, sales volume was in line with the prior year, despite continued declines in demand. For functional films, sales volume rose above the prior year, owing to replacement demand for mobile devices and other factors. In overseas operations, Ｏｐａｌ's Maryvale plant was affected by a suspension of operations for about one month due to a labor dispute and by the translation effect of the stronger yen, but revenue rose above the prior year, as the effect of the large-scale maintenance shutdown of manufacturing equipment at Nippon Dynawave Packaging in the prior year no longer applied, among other factors.
